| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|

| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 1.0 | Flag not raised |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 5, 8) · ↓ invasive · High score; lower invasive association · Validated [F2]
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 6) · ↓ invasive · Low score; lower invasive association · Validated [F3]
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Scarce here; linked to invasive · Validated [F4]
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 5, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · High score; spot check 12/20 · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion gap 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown to reflect classifier use; no cited concept Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated JPEG degradation (severity 3); reliability error AUROC only 0.69.
- Only 2 of 5 similar cases are Benign; an Invasive one has 0.82 similarity.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 6** — look for infiltrating tumor; benign stroma is scarce.
2. **Regions 5, 9, 11** — verify ducts confine the atypia; concept spot check only 12/20.
3. **Regions 3, 5, 8** — confirm gland architecture is benign-appearing, not neoplastic.
